release_read.basis: Q3 revenue $139M against a $122.4M bar (about +14%, above even the hunt's $128-132M run-rate case) and a fourth raise of the FY guide to $520-530M from $490-500M with adjusted EBITDA guide to $90-100M; offset by the stock sitting at a 52-week high after +57% since the last print and part of the growth being Naveris/NavDx acquired volume.

release.headline: CareDx reports Q3 2026 results: revenue $139M (+39% y/y), raises FY2026 guidance to $520-530M

vs_bar.consensus_source: Nasdaq EPS forecast in brief (fallback, 1 estimate)

key_line.metric: Q3 revenue vs guide-midpoint bar and FY guide
key_line.detail: Testing services $119M (+65% y/y), volume ~75,900 (+51%, includes NavDx); GAAP net income $19M; adj. EBITDA $30M vs $15M. Release time not verified beyond amc 2026-10-29 (8-K filed that date); figures from the search summary of the 8-K exhibit, page not fetched.

guidance.detail: FY2026 revenue $520-530M (was $490-500M); adj. EBITDA $90-100M (was $66-78M per search summary). Street had expected a raise; the size beats the run-rate case.

call.detail: Call was last night after the release; not reviewed for lack of time, so no call-only number is used.

public_reaction.summary: Not searched before compile (time); no analyst actions recorded.

tape_read.note: Robust reference 78.90 = +10.3% vs prev close 71.52, close to the frozen +11% release read and inside the 15.8% implied move. The after-hours ran to 82.40 (+15.2%) and the pre-market high was 83.88, so the move has already sagged from the night's peak to 78-79. 29 prints, 8 in the last 30 min, last at 09:08, not stale. Market is weak: QQQ -2.6%, SPY -1.0%.

thesis_check.note: Panel thesis was a run-rate beat ($128-132M vs $122.4M) and a fourth raise; the print beat even that and raised. The panel's offset (52-week high, post-run prints sold) is what the overnight sag looks like.

expected.open_lag_note: Active, non-stale pre-market on an amc print read overnight, so the open should hold most of the +10% gap; the gap already faded from +15% after hours, the stock ran 57% into the print and the Nasdaq is down 2.6%, which favours further giveback after the open.

recommendation.reason: De cijfers waren duidelijk beter dan verwacht en de jaarverwachting is opnieuw verhoogd, maar de voorbeurs (+10%) prijst dat al ongeveer volledig in. De koers zakte vannacht al terug van +15%, het aandeel steeg flink voor de cijfers en de beurs staat zwak; verkoop daarom op de opening, gelijk aan de standaardregel.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Als de voorbeurs voor 09:30 weer richting de nachtelijke top (rond 82-84) loopt, of er een reeks koersdoelverhogingen binnenkomt, is vasthouden tot 10:00 te overwegen.
